name: Serpinopathy

criteria.description: Demonstration of serpin protein deficiency or dysfunction via biochemical assays
Presence of characteristic clinical manifestations such as emphysema, liver disease, or neurodegeneration
Identification of pathogenic variants in serpin genes (e.g., SERPINA1 mutations)
Histological evidence of serpin polymer accumulation in affected tissues

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of serpin protein deficiency or dysfunction plus characteristic clinical features and confirmatory genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may be supported by histopathological findings and family history.

imaging: Chest CT showing panacinar emphysema predominantly in lower lobes
Liver ultrasound or MRI indicating cirrhosis or fibrosis
genetic: Pathogenic variants in SERPINA1 or other serpin genes confirmed by molecular testing
other: Histopathology showing intracellular serpin polymer accumulation in hepatocytes or neurons

distinguishingFeatures: Peripheral neuropathy without liver or lung involvement

redFlags: Early onset panacinar emphysema in non-smokers
Unexplained liver cirrhosis with serpin polymer accumulation
Progressive neurodegeneration with serpinopathy genetic findings
